story: Zoe and Raj are in the living room looking for something to watch or read. They look at the television and a magazine, but they want more news. Finally, they find a video on a tablet.
title: Looking for News
setting: A bright living room with a large window.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: A young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt.

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: A young boy with glasses and a blue sweater.

sentences.en: Zoe looks at a pretty magazine.
sentences.zh: Zoe 看著一本漂亮的杂志。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with short black hair and a yellow shirt, looks at a pretty magazine on a table.

sentences.en: Raj reads a very large newspaper.
sentences.zh: Raj 正在读一份非常大的报纸。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young boy with glasses and a blue sweater, reads a very large newspaper.

sentences.en: The television is on in the room.
sentences.scene_prompt: A television is on in the bright living room.

sentences.en: They want to hear the radio news.
sentences.zh: 他们想听收音机里的新闻。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe and Raj sit near a small radio on a table.

sentences.en: Why is there no information here?
sentences.zh: 为什么这里没有信息呢？
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe looks confused while looking at an empty table.

sentences.en: They watch a short video or film.
sentences.zh: 他们看一段短视频或电影。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe and Raj watch a short video on a tablet together.
